title: Privacy shifts favor first-party event tracking
body: Privacy changes are pushing teams toward first-party event tracking rather than third-party scripts.

title: Amplitude shipped an AI copilot for funnels
body: Amplitude shipped an AI copilot that narrates funnels from generic templates.

title: Mixpanel added natural language questions
body: Mixpanel added natural language questions over existing dashboards.

title: PMs expect self-serve analytics
body: Product managers increasingly expect self-serve analytics and do not want to wait on a data team for routine questions.

title: A startup launched a self-serve canvas for PMs
body: A startup launched a self-serve analytics canvas for product managers who refuse to wait on a data team.

title: Session replay is becoming a bundled expectation
body: PostHog keeps winning evaluations where session replay is bundled into the analytics suite.

title: Instrumentation took three weeks
body: Event instrumentation took three weeks because every new event waited on engineering.

title: PMs are afraid to touch the tracking plan
body: How do you let PMs add events without breaking the tracking plan?

title: Not self-serve for PMs
body: This is not self-serve for PMs. I still file a ticket with the data team for basic questions.

title: Analysis ends up in spreadsheets
body: I export every analysis to a spreadsheet because I cannot segment without SQL.

title: AI insights ignore our events
body: The AI insights read like a generic summary and ignore our real event names.

title: We explain activation with session replay
body: The only way we explain activation drop-off today is session replay.

title: Dark mode for late work
body: Could you add a dark mode? I check dashboards late at night.

title: Would love dark mode
body: Would love a dark mode for late-night checks. Everything else is fine.

title: New workspaces stall during instrumentation
body: Most new workspaces never get past event instrumentation, so later analysis never becomes trustworthy.

title: Tracking plans lift weekly active PMs
body: Workspaces that keep a tracking plan have much higher weekly active product managers.

title: Funnel analysis is rare among PM seats
body: Funnel analysis is self-serve for analysts and rare for PMs: analyst seats live in the builder, PM seats do not.

title: AI insight cards are dismissed immediately
body: AI insight cards are dismissed within five seconds by most viewers.

title: Natural language questions are abandoned
body: People try a natural language question once, then leave when the answer does not match their events.

title: Session replay is already how activation gets investigated
body: Session replay is opened for the majority of activation investigations.
